visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a person's hands using red-handled scissors to chop cooked chicken and cabbage inside a large metal dog bowl. The bowl sits on a metal table, and a second person is partially visible in the background, seated in a pink chair. (2) The camera pans down to the tiled floor, revealing a Corgi dog with a multicolored braided collar sitting under a pink plastic chair, looking up expectantly. (3) A second Corgi walks into the frame, and both dogs are shown staring toward the food preparation area. The person continues to snip the food into smaller pieces. (4) The camera focuses on the faces of the Corgis as they bark excitedly; their mouths are wide open, and their eyes are fixed on the bowl. (5) The person preparing the food reaches down to pet one of the Corgis on the head. (6) The camera returns to the bowl, showing the final texture of the prepared meal before the video ends.
